description_en: Modifies the layout of a production studio
kebab_example: aliyun live modify-studio-layout --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id a2b8e671-2fe5-4642-a2ec-bf93880e0000 --layout-id 445409ec-7eaa-461d-8f29-4bec2eb90000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyStudioLayout

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio. ><notice>The production studio must be created in advance and must be of the virtual studio type.></notice>

If you create a production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, use the CasterId value returned in the response.

If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the ApsaraVideo Live console > Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio page to view the ID.

The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。
<notice>需要提前创建好，必须是虚拟演播厅类型的导播台。
</notice>


如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the layout. If you add a layout for a production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848062.html operation, use the LayoutId value returned in the response
parameters.help_zh: 布局ID。如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848062.html添加虚拟演播厅的布局设置，请查看AddStudioLayout接口调用返回的参数LayoutId值
parameters.name: layout_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the production studio layout
parameters.name: layout_name

parameters.help_en: The configuration of the common layout. This parameter is a JSON string. For more information, see CommonConfig. ><notice>This parameter is required only when LayoutType is set to common.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
通用布局配置。格式为JSON字符串，请参见CommonConfig。
<notice>当LayoutType取值为common时，本参数才必填。
</notice>
parameters.name: common_config

parameters.help_en:
The configuration of the background resource. This parameter is a JSON string. For more information, see BgImageConfig.

<notice>

This parameter is required only when LayoutType is set to studio.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
背景资源配置。格式为JSON字符串，请参见BgImageConfig。

<notice>当LayoutType取值为studio时，本参数才必填。
</notice>
parameters.name: bg_image_config

parameters.help_en:
The settings for the chroma keying input. This parameter is a JSON string. For more information, see ScreenInputConfig.

<notice>

This parameter is required only when LayoutType is set to studio.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
抠像输入设置。格式为JSON字符串，请参见ScreenInputConfig。

<notice>当LayoutType取值为studio时，本参数才必填。
</notice>
parameters.name: screen_input_config_list

parameters.help_en:
The settings for the multimedia input resource. This parameter is a JSON string. For more information, see MediaInputConfig.

<notice>

This parameter is valid and optional only when LayoutType is set to studio.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
多媒体输入资源设置。格式为JSON字符串，请参见MediaInputConfig。

<notice>当LayoutType取值为studio时，本参数才有效，且为选填。
</notice>
parameters.name: media_input_config_list

parameters.help_en: The layer order settings. This parameter is a JSON string. For more information, see layerOrderConfig. You can sort background and multimedia materials. Chroma keying layers are not supported. The earlier an item appears in the list, the lower its layer
parameters.help_zh:
图层顺序设置。格式为JSON字符串，请参见layerOrderConfig。
支持背景素材、多媒体素材排序，暂不支持抠像层。越排在前面，越在底层
parameters.name: layer_order_config_list
